objectives: 介紹環工物化處理程序之原理 操控因子 使學生對於各處理系統之基本學理有更多的基礎
content:

Precipitation
Flocculation/Coagulation
Sedimentation
Filtration

Membrane“

AWWA, “Water Quality and Treatment”, 4th ed., Mc-Graw Hill, 1990.
Samual W. Faust and Osman M, Aly, “Adsorption Processes for Water Treatment,” Butterworths, Boston, 1987.
C. Gottschalk, J. A. Libra, A. Saupe, “Ozonation of Water and Waste Water,” Wiley-Vch, New York, 2000.
